x: The performances of Scamell, since he started last year, have been truly remarkable for in some 12 races he has gained as many prizes. The sealed handicap in the run was voted a good thing for J.
On viewing the entries there seemed a very sporting chance of finishing in the first twelve places but a series of misfortunes decided that this was not to be. J.
O'Kell are now not eligible by the rules to compete, together with J.
6. · E A Duffett · 15 · 46 · 12. · J D Andrews · — · —
Our team was Ken O'Kell(3), Mick Pyer(4), Bert Footer(8), Jack Andrews (17), Bert Smith(21), Harry Bruce(26). Our 79 points gave us a two point win over Epsom H, with Surrey AC third.

Then came the "turn-up" in J.Andrews who showed wonderful improvement and helped considerably to withstand the efforts of our Epsom friends so that eventually we ran out winners of our first Cross Country Championship by a margin of 2 points.
